text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21 valproate sodium has been on FDA's shortage list for 70 months. Current stock: Corvale East 500 mg/5 mL 56 vials (17.1 days), 100 mg/mL 13 vials (3.8 days); Corvale General 58.85 vials (13.5 days) and 64.48 vials (15 days); Corvale Lakeside 100 mg/mL 12 vials (15.2 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage posting for valproate sodium is current since 2020-12-30. Fresenius Kabi plant FEI 3001833549 received an OAI classification letter on 2017-12-28, 1098 days before the shortage posting; later inspections returned to VAI. Hikma plant FEI 3002807173 received an OAI classification on 2014-03-28 and a Warning Letter on 2014-10-21; most recent inspection VAI on 2023-04-21. Sagent Pharmaceuticals is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East 100 mg/mL is critically low at 3.8 days. Other sites have 13–17 days. P&T-approved interchange options exist for Hikma 500 mg/5 mL (approved 2025-12-04) and Fresenius Kabi 100 mg/mL (approved 2026-04-19), both requiring pharmacist verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Sagent Pharmaceuticals for valproate sodium; buyer approves purchase.
2. Pharmacists to verify and dispense Hikma 500 mg/5 mL per P&T approval (2025-12-04); pharmacist approves each use.
3. Pharmacists to verify and dispense Fresenius Kabi 100 mg/mL per P&T approval (2026-04-19); pharmacist approves each use.
4. Buyer to monitor daily inventory at all Corvale sites and report to P&T weekly; buyer approves reporting cadence.

Not recommended: Switching to unapproved manufacturers or concentrations without P&T review; allocating stock based on site preference rather than days-on-hand.
